versions.subject: feat: add new rules related to linux reverse shells (#4166)
versions.detection:
selection_nc:
    Image|endswith:
       - '/nc'
       - '/ncat'
selection_flags:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' -c '
        - ' -e '
selection_shell:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' ash'
        - ' bash'
        - ' bsh'
        - ' csh'
        - ' ksh'
        - ' pdksh'
        - ' sh'
        - ' tcsh'
        - '/bin/ash'
        - '/bin/bash'
        - '/bin/bsh'
        - '/bin/csh'
        - '/bin/ksh'
        - '/bin/pdksh'
        - '/bin/sh'
        - '/bin/tcsh'
        - '/bin/zsh'
        - '$IFSash'
        - '$IFSbash'
        - '$IFSbsh'
        - '$IFScsh'
        - '$IFSksh'
        - '$IFSpdksh'
        - '$IFSsh'
        - '$IFStcsh'
        - '$IFSzsh'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*/nc", "*/ncat") CommandLine IN ("* -c *", "* -e *") CommandLine IN ("* ash*", "* bash*", "* bsh*", "* csh*", "* ksh*", "* pdksh*", "* sh*", "* tcsh*", "*/bin/ash*", "*/bin/bash*", "*/bin/bsh*", "*/bin/csh*", "*/bin/ksh*", "*/bin/pdksh*", "*/bin/sh*", "*/bin/tcsh*", "*/bin/zsh*", "*$IFSash*", "*$IFSbash*", "*$IFSbsh*", "*$IFScsh*", "*$IFSksh*", "*$IFSpdksh*", "*$IFSsh*", "*$IFStcsh*", "*$IFSzsh*")
